construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict synthetic JSON object with catalog product feed, consented customer profile and preferences, basket lines, ordered clickstream event log, and research query
shared_schema.output: One JSON object: schema_version, status, synthetic, ordered stages, notice. Each stage has schema_version, stage, status, input_digest, data.
shared_schema.validation: Shared Validation class rejects unknown/missing fields, invalid units and types, duplicate identifiers, missing consent, non-catalog basket data, stock overruns and unsupported evidence. Each deterministic stage output is validated before handoff.
shared_schema.prices: Nonnegative integer USD cents; shown price and stock copied directly from catalog.
shared_schema.citations: Selected SKU, globally unique source_id and zero-based Python Unicode character offsets [start,end); quote equals exact source substring.
shared_schema.errors: Validation/file errors yield one stdout JSON object with status error and CLI exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs.validation: Validated comparison record and SHA-256 predecessor digest
Validated two-step prerequisite plan; selected-SKU-only evidence retrieval
Exact extractive source citations carried into onboarding

behavior.compare: Normalize kg/g and l/ml; side-by-side catalog offers; eligibility uses budget, capacity, waterproof preference and stock remaining after existing basket quantities. Rank by price/weight/capacity priority, then consented clickstream interest, then SKU.
behavior.journey: Two planned next actions: inspect_specs then preview_basket; prerequisite availability is simulated and checked in order.
behavior.normal: Deterministic case-insensitive word-overlap retrieval of up to three selected-product passages; full-passage extraction with exact citations; fail closed when no evidence matches.
behavior.adaptive: Novice guided walkthrough or experienced quick check with preference explanations, followed by prerequisite-gated basket preview confirmation. Carries source evidence and journey forward; preview adds one selected unit without placing an order.
behavior.industry_constraints: Explicit personalization consent checked before ranking; no review/endorsement schema accepted or generated; catalog price/stock are authoritative. Demonstrative GDPR/CCPA-style checks, not legal compliance certification.
behavior.fixture: All SKUs, shopper identities, products, prices, stock and source passages are clearly labeled synthetic fiction.

included: One shared input/output contract and validator

test_outcomes.cli_output: One JSON object with status ok and four validated stages
test_outcomes.error_cli_verified: Missing file, missing argument, malformed/duplicate JSON and invalid fixtures return JSON status error and exit 2
